opening.argument: The video presents a practical walkthrough for obtaining support for a Google My Business listing, directing viewers to phone, email, chat, and callback options. It explains that a callback request requires entering ordinary business details, including the business name, address, and listing URL, before clicking Next to schedule the callback. The supplied support screen likewise shows Call, Chat, and Email options, while the form displays fields for the business relationship, issue description, business name, address, and public page URL. This is an operational customer-support demonstration, with no payment request, investment offer, promised returns, or request to transfer credentials shown.

citations.quote: I'm going to show you very quickly on how to find the area on this site where you can get phone support, email support, or even chat support.
put your business name and address
once you fill that in, you're gonna click Next and it's gonna schedule a callback.
